Clean flat textbook illustration style, white background, clear bold text.

A map of Nigeria circa 1920 divided into three major regions: North, West, and East. The Northern region is shaded green and. The Western region is shaded yellow and. The Eastern region is shaded red and. Clean flat textbook illustration style, clear borders, white background.

An illustration of the Aba Women's Movement. A large crowd of Nigerian women in traditional 1920s Eastern Nigerian attire (wrappers, some with palm fronds in their hair or hands). They are surrounding a wooden "Native Court" building, looking angry and singing. In the foreground, a woman (representing Nwanyeruwa) points accusingly at a shocked man holding a census clipboard (representing the Warrant Chief's agent). Clean flat textbook illustration style, white background.
